entities.summary: John Alvin Anderson was a Swedish-American photographer who spent most of his life in the United States. He is known for photographing Sioux people at the Rosebud Indian Reservation in South Dakota from 1885 until 1930. Many of his works are displayed at the Nebraska State Historical Society in Lincoln, Nebraska.
